controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T10:03:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T11:03:30.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND user.name == "sre.alice"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, user.name,
           auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*","publickey", message LIKE "*password*","password","other")
| SORT accepted DESC
